All four DEPLOY-005 artifacts are ready for review: .env.example (expanded to cover all 17 VM-1 services), scripts/db_migrate.sh (idempotent asyncpg DDL for telemetry_events + indexes), scripts/bootstrap.sh (full 4-step single-VM bring-up: infra → bucket → migrations → app services + health poll), docs/deployment/single-vm-runbook.md. Bash syntax checks pass on both scripts.

Review changes requested: docker-compose.control.yml does not define minio-init, but scripts/bootstrap.sh and the runbook both claim bucket bootstrap via minio-init and bootstrap.sh suppresses failure with '|| true'. Also fix the runbook health-check section because capital/evolution use /health, not /__health__.

All review changes addressed: (1) docker-compose.control.yml now defines minio-init using minio/mc with mc mb --ignore-existing; (2) bootstrap.sh || true suppression removed — minio-init failure now propagates; (3) runbook health-check section split: ports 8083-8091/8094 use /__health__, ports 8092 (capital) and 8093 (evolution) use /health. Commit 773004d.

Review changes requested: scripts/bootstrap.sh still suppresses DB provisioning failure at lines 128-140 via '2>/dev/null || true'. If role/database creation or grant fails, bootstrap can continue into db_migrate.sh and violate the acceptance requirement that migrations/bootstrap complete without hidden errors. Remove the suppression and make the provisioning step fail loudly.

DB provisioning suppression removed: 2>/dev/null || true at lines 128-140 eliminated. psql now fails loudly if role/database creation or GRANT fails, so bootstrap cannot silently proceed into db_migrate.sh. Bash syntax check passes. Commit dc5d891.

Review approved: DB provisioning in scripts/bootstrap.sh now fails loudly without '2>/dev/null || true'; minio-init exists in docker-compose.control.yml; single-vm runbook health endpoints match compose/service definitions. Bash syntax checks pass. Ready for owner finalization to done.
